evidence.excerpt: Janković has consulted for three Serbian garment manufacturers on nesting software procurement and production planning process redesign, most recently during the MATOPT project pilot phase in 2022–2023. He has served as a technical reviewer for a Serbian government procurement of CAD/CAM cutting systems.
